feats.name: Investigator
feats.description:
You have an eye for detail and can pick out the smallest 
clues. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 
20. 
• You gain proficiency in Investigation or the Forensics 
Kit (Pick one). If you are already proficient, you 
instead gain Mastery. 
• You can take the Search action or make an Intelligence 
(Investigation) check as a bonus action. 
• When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) check, 
if your result is 5 or higher than the DC, you gain 
additional information or clues into the given mystery 
or situation. 
• By spending 10 minutes studying an area the size of a 
small room, you can begin to see echoes of the last 24 
hours in the given area. This echo plays in your mind 
as if watching a movie backwards and all the actors are 
featureless humanoid figures which yo u cannot 
attribute a name or face to. This scene plays out in its 
entirety, and you can rewind, slow down, or speed up 
this echo at will. You cannot replay an echo if 24 hours 
has passed. While viewing this echo, you can make 
Intelligence (Investigation) c hecks of varying 
difficulty set by the DM to gather information from 
the echo based on what’s happening.

feats.name: Master Of Disguise
feats.description:
You have honed your ability to shape your personality and 
visage into that of others with a surprising level of detail. 
You gain the following benefits: 
• You gain proficiency with the disguise kit. 
• You gain proficiency with performance. If you are already 
proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• You can make Charisma (Performance) checks in place of 
Deception checks. 
• When you are mimicking a target, you have advantage on 
performance checks made to impersonate that target. 
• Reduce the time it takes to make a disguise when using a 
disguise kit by a factor of up to 10. Plain disguises now 
only take 1 minute. Elaborate disguises now only take 10 
minutes, and exquisite disguises now only takes 1 hour.

feats.name: Poisoner
feats.description:
You have studied the secrets of poisons and toxins, 
gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency with the poisoner’s kit. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• Reduce the DC to create Poisons by an amount equal to 
your Ninjutsu ability modifier. 
• You can apply a poison to a weapon as a part of the 
same action use to attack with the weapon, once per 
turn. 
• During a short rest, you can infuse your chakra into a 
single dose of poison. To use this benefit, you must 
have a poisoner’s kit & have a poison of any type. You 
can only have one infused poison this way. This 
infused poison can use either its listed Save DC or your 
Ninjutsu Save DC (You decide.). Additionally, if it deals 
damage, it deals additional damage equal to an 
amount of damage die, equal to half of your 
proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Practiced Adept
feats.description:
You have acquired skills over your career, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or 
tools of your choice. 
• You can take this feat multiple times.

feats.name: Practiced Expert
feats.description:
You have honed your proficiency with particular skills or 
tools, gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase any ability score of your choice by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain +1 ranks of Mastery in any two Skills or Toolkits 
you are proficient in. You cannot select the same 
Skill/Toolkit twice.9 
• You can take this feat multiple times.

feats.name: Quick Fingered
feats.description:
Your nimble fingers and agility let you perform sleight of 
hand. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• You can perform a Sleight of hand check as a bonus 
action. 
• Your skills in thievery are so great that you can even 
pickpocket or plant something up to 30 feet away. 
• As a reaction to a creature making a weapon attack 
targeting you, you can make a Dexterity (Sleight of 
hand) check vs the targets attack roll. On a success, 
you disarm them so quickly that they are unaware you 
have disarmed them. Their attack becomes an 
unarmed attack. They don’t become aware that they 
have been disarmed until after the attack has 
concluded.

feats.name: Stealthy
feats.description:
You know how best to hide. You gain the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Stealth skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• You can perform the Hide action as a bonus action. 
• If you are hidden, you gain a +20 bonus to your 
movement speed when sneaking. 
• Creatures have a-5 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) 
checks made to search for you, while you are hidden 
from them.

feats.name: Menacing
feats.description:
You become fearsome to others, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• You can attempt the Demoralize Skill Action, as a Bonus 
Action. 
• You can attempt the Demoralize Skill Action against the 
same creature up to three times, before they become 
accustomed to your intimidating presence.

feats.name: Ninshou Research
feats.description:
You have begun to deep dive into the lore, mechanics and 
purpose of Ninjutsu. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Ninshou skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• When you would make an Identify Ninjutsu check, you 
reduce the DC, by 5. 
• If you would attempt a Read the Enemy check, on a 
creature casting a Ninjutsu, you no longer need to see 
a creatures using Handsigns to attempt this check, and 
you increase the AC bonus you would gain to +3. 
• You reduce the downtime needed to learn Ninjutsu 
using the self-taught method by an amount equal to 
the rank of the jutsu. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, 
A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5.)

feats.name: Martial Arts Research
feats.description:
You have begun to research the history of Martial arts 
and how they have changed over the generations. You 
gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence or Strength by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Martial Arts skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• When you would make an Identify Taijutsu/Bukijutsu 
check, you reduce the DC, by 5. 
• If you would attempt a Read the Enemy check, on a 
creature casting a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you gain 5 
damage reduction to the Taijutsu or Bukijutsu cast. 
• Select one between the following; Taijutsu or 
Bukijutsu. You reduce the downtime needed 
to learn the chosen type using the self-taught method by an amount equal to the 
rank of the jutsu. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-
Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5.)

feats.name: Illusionist Research
feats.description:
You have begun to find some truth in the world of 
illusions and Genjutsu, finding its origins to be darker 
and more sinister than you once thought. You gain the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in the Illusions skill. If you are 
already proficient, you instead gain Mastery. 
• When you would make an Identify Genjutsu check, you 
reduce the DC, by 5. 
• If you would attempt a Read the Enemy check, on a 
creature casting a Genjutsu, you no longer need to see 
a creatures using Handsigns to attempt this check, and 
you gain a +2 bonus to saving throws made against 
this Genjutsu’s casting, until the beginning of your 
next turn. 
• You reduce the downtime needed to learn Genjutsu 
using the self-taught method by an amount equal to 
the rank of the jutsu. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, 
A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5.)

feats.name: Chakra Construction
feats.description:
You’ve learned to efficiently create constructs of chakra, 
maximizing their potential for less. You gain the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• When you are concentrating on a jutsu with the 
Construct keyword, the first time you would make a 
concentration check as the result of damage per 
round, you automatically succeed the check. 
• When you cast a jutsu with the Construct keyword, you 
may apply two of the following benefits. You cannot 
select the same benefit more than once. 
 ◦ Damage rolls from these constructs pierce any 
passive DR a target possesses. 
 ◦ These constructs increase their attack rolls by 
+1, and impose a-1 penalty to saving throws 
they impose. 
 ◦ These constructs gain an amount of DR against 
all damage equal to your jutsu casting modifier. 
 ◦ These constructs increase their AC by half your 
jutsu casting modifier.

feats.name: Chakra Guidance
feats.description:
You’ve learned to utilize your gift with Chakra in a 
specific unique way. You gain the following benefits. 
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• Choose a skill in which you are proficient. When you 
make a skill check with the chosen skill, you can use 
your Wisdom or Charisma modifier in place of its 
original ability score. 
• Jutsu, you encounter are far easier to deal with due to 
your unique quirks with Chakra. When you would 
attempt to interrupt or dispel a jutsu another creature 
cast or are currently concentrating on, you gain a 1d4 
bonus towards any checks you make towards 
interrupting or dispelling their jutsu. 
• Jutsu, you cast are far more difficult to recognize, and 
therefore more difficult to plan against. When a 
creature would attempt to interrupt or dispel a jutsu 
you cast or are concentrating on, they take a 1d4 
penalty to any checks made to do either of tho se.

feats.name: Chakra Pressure
feats.description:
You have a very powerful Chakra aura. You gain the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• Select between; Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. 
Jutsu you use that have one of the aforementioned 
keywords, that require a creature make a Saving throw, 
cannot add Jutsu based bonuses to their save unless the 
jutsu granting the bonus is of a ran k higher than the jutsu 
you originally cast. 
• Your chakra is heavy and carries a weight unlike any 
other. Jutsu you cast with the chakra molding (CM) 
component, that summons a creature, construct or object 
with hit points or temporary hit points. That creature, 
construct or object gains a number of ad ditional hit points 
equal to twice your constitution modifier (min 2.) 
• Your chakra-based constructs are more difficult for 
enemies to disrupt or dispel. When a creature would 
attempt to interrupt or dispel a jutsu or feature you cast 
that would summon a creature, construct or object with hit 
points or temporary hit points, in crease their DC to do so 
by +2.

feats.name: Endurance, Latent
feats.description:
You have a great deal of chakra within you ready to come 
out. You gain the following benefits; 
• Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum 
of 20 
• When you roll a Chakra Die to regain chakra points, 
you treat all 1’s as 2’s. 
• Your chakra point maximum increases by an amount 
equal to your level when you gain this feat. Whenever 
you gain a level thereafter, your chakra points 
maximum increases by an additional 1 chakra point. 
• As a full turn action, you can draw on the well of 
chakra within yourself. You can spend up to 4 chakra 
die. When you do, roll all chakra die spent, gaining 
chakra points equal to the result. You then gain 1 rank 
of exhaustion for the next hour.

feats.name: Endurance, Realized
feats.description:
You have a much deeper pool of chakra reserves than 
previously thought. You gain the following benefits; 
• Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum 
of 20. 
• You gain resistance to Chakra Damage. 
• Your chakra point maximum increases by an amount 
equal to your level when you gain this feat. Whenever 
you gain a level thereafter, your chakra points 
maximum increases by an additional 1 chakra point. 
• Your Chakra point maximum cannot be reduced by 
hostile effects

feats.name: Improved Chakra Efficiency
feats.description:
You have gained greater control over your chakra, gaining 
the following benefits: 
• Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 
20. 
• You may select 2 Jutsu you currently have. That jutsu cost 
is reduced by an amount equal to its rank. You can change 
this choice, when you would complete a long rest. (D-
Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) 
• You may select one class feature you currently have that 
costs chakra. You may use this feature at 0 cost, twice per 
long rest. If the feature selected can have its cost 
increased for a larger benefit, it cannot be selected as an 
option for this feat. If a feature has sub-features and/or 
multiple costs, pick one to apply this feat to. 
• If you do not have a class feature that costs chakra, you 
instead gain 1 additional use of a class feature that would 
normally refresh when you complete a short or long rest. 
You cannot switch the feature that this feat benefits.

feats.name: Medical Release
feats.description:
You learn how to mold chakra in ways befitting of a bonified 
Medical-Nin. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You are now able to add jutsu with the Medical keyword. 
• You learn one jutsu with the Medical keyword. 
• Over the course of a long rest, you can remove any one 
condition or disease of C-Rank or lower, currently 
affecting yourself or a single ally who you can reach for 
the duration of the long rest. At the end of the rest, they 
are healed of the disease or condition, gain the benefits of 
a long rest, and gain resistance to the disease or condition 
until their next rest.

feats.name: Nature Release
feats.description:
You learn how to mold chakra into one of the 5 
Elements, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence Score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You select one of the 5 Following Nature 
Releases. Fire, Water, Lightning, Wind, 
Earth. You are now able to add jutsu with 
the corresponding Keyword to your jutsu 
list. 
• You learn one jutsu with the corresponding 
Nature Release that you selected, that you 
qualify for. 
• You can take this feat more than once, each 
time selecting a different nature 
release.

feats.name: Streamlined Chakra Efficiency
feats.description:
Your chakra network is unlike most others. You can get 
twice the results from your network in half the effort 
granting you the following benefits: 
• Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 
20. 
• Select one Category of Jutsu between Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, 
Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. The cost to maintain concentration 
of a jutsu of the chosen type, is reduced by 1, to a 
minimum of 1. 
• When you would successfully complete a short rest and 
spend 3 or more chakra die, you regain 1 chakra die at the 
conclusion of calculating how much chakra you regain. 
• You gain DR (damage reduction) vs Chakra damage, equal 
to your proficiency bonus. 
• Hostile effects that would increase the base cost of jutsu 
you cast have their effects Halved. This does not count for 
the Sealed condition. (Ex. If a hostile effect increases the base 
cost of a Jutsu you cast by 4, it instead only increases it by 2.)

feats.name: Seal Resistant
feats.description:
Your chakra is resilient to the effects of most sealing 
attempts. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain a +2 bonus to Charisma saving throws vs jutsu 
with the Fuinjutsu keyword. 
• You make checks to remove the Sealed condition at 
advantage. 
• If a jutsu, effect, feature or trait would attempt to remove 
your ability to mold chakra without a saving throw, you 
instead make a constitution saving throw vs the jutsu 
types save DC. If the effect was not cause by a jutsu, you 
instead make a DC 20 const itution saving throw, 
retaining your ability to mold chakra on a successful 
save.

feats.name: Clone Specialization
feats.prerequisite: Any Ninjutsu with the Clone Keyword, Level 4+
feats.description:
You’ve become adept at ordering your clones to make a series 
of tactical maneuvers and actions. You gain the following 
benefits; 
• When you summon no more than two clones, and are 
within 60 feet of terrain that could obscure them that you 
can see, that can hold them, you can make an Intelligence 
(Stealth) check vs the highest hostile creatures’ passive 
perception. On a success, your c lones are undetected. 
• When you summon at least 3 clones, and a hostile creature 
you can see is within 30 feet of you, you can cause your 
summons to flank the target by summoning them in spaces 
adjacent to them. When you do, the target suffers a-1 
Penalty to their AC until the beginning of their next turn 
for each clone that is summoned within 5 feet of them 
(Max-3). 
• As a bonus action, all clones within 60 feet of you moves up 
to 30 feet, ending their movement as close as possible to a 
single hostile creature you can see within 60 feet. For every 
clone that ends its movement within 15 feet of them, you 
increase the next melee attacks damage you deal by 1d8. 
• As a bonus action, by commanding your clones to Rush and 
Raid, you select up to three hostile creatures you can see 
within 60 feet of you. All clones are forced to move up to 60 
feet, ending their movement as close as possible to the 
target. For every clon e that ends its movement within 15 
feet of the hostile creature, the next jutsu the target casts 
that would increase its AC, gain temporary hit points, or 
reduce damage suffers a penalty based on the following, 
until the end of their next turn. 
▪ Bonus AC: Reduce AC Bonus by-1, for every 2 
Clones within range. 
▪ Temporary Hit Points: Reduce temporary hit 
points gained by 1d4 for every clone within range. 
▪ Damage Reduction: Reduce Damage Reduction 
benefit by-1, for every clone within range.

feats.name: Earth Release Expert
feats.description:
Your mastery with earth natured chakra is so great, you 
emanate gold, silver, and platinum chakra each time you 
mold earth chakra to cast a Ninjutsu with the earth release 
keyword. 
When casting a Ninjutsu with the earth release 
keyword, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 

• Constructs and structures you summon that would 
intercept damage gain additional hit points equal to the 
rank of the jutsu cast. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +8, 
B-Rank: +12, A-Rank: +16, S-Rank: +20) 
• Constructs, structures, and objects made as a result of 
Jutsu cast with the Earth release keyword are no longer 
vulnerable to Lightning damage. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Elemental Chakra Penetration
feats.description:
When you gain this feat, choose one of the following 
damage types: Earth, Wind, Fire, Cold, Lightning. 
Ninjutsu, you cast ignore resistance to damage of the 
chosen type. 
In addition, when you roll damage for a jutsu you cast 
that deals damage of that type, you can reroll 1’s and 2’s, 
keeping the second result. 
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you 
do so, you must choose a different damage type.

feats.name: Elemental Specialization
feats.description:
You have begun to specialize in a particular element of 
your choice. You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one Nature Release Keyword (Earth, Wind, Fire, 
Water, Lightning). You may ignore Hand Seal (HS) 
requirement for Ninjutsu of C-Rank of lower with your 
chosen nature release. 
• You deal additional damage with Ninjutsu with your 
chosen Nature Release Keyword, equal to its rank. ( D-
Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) 
• You reduce the chakra cost of Ninjutsu with your 
chosen Nature Release keyword by an amount equal to 
its rank. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, 
S-Rank: 5). 
• You can take this feat multiple times, each time 
selecting a different element.

feats.name: Empowered Ninjutsu
feats.description:
You learn to empower your Ninjutsu with more precise 
chakra, empowering its effects. You gain the following 
benefits: 
• When you cast a ninjutsu you know, you can spend 10 
chakra. If you do, you double the jutsu’s potential 
impact granting it one of the following effects based; 
 ◦ If your ninjutsu requires an attack roll, when you 
roll damage die, you treat all 1’s and 2’s as 3. 
 ◦ If your ninjutsu forces a creature to make a saving 
throw, if they would take a reaction in response to 
your ninjutsu, they double the chakra cost of the 
jutsu used. If the reaction they took does not cost 
chakra, they instead must spend 10 chakra to take 
the reaction. 
• Ninjutsu you cast cannot have its damage reduced by 
more than half as a result of Jutsu, Features or Traits. 
Creatures with natural resistances or immunities still 
reduce damage as normal. 
• When you would make a Constitution (Chakra control) 
check to maintain concentration on a Ninjutsu you 
cast, you may add a bonus to the check equal to the 
highest ranked Ninjutsu you are concentrating on. ( D-
Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5).

feats.name: Fire Release Expert
feats.description:
Your mastery with fire natured chakra is so great, flames 
you conjure burn twice as hot, with half the effort. 
When casting a Ninjutsu with the fire release keyword, 
you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20 
• For every fire damage dice you roll, you pierces through 1 
of a creatures DR (damage reduction), up to a max of 10. 
• When you would cast a Ninjutsu with the fire release 
keyword that creates a Cone, sphere or line, you can 
increase the size of the area or length of the line by 10 
feet. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Lightning Release Expert
feats.description:
Your mastery with lightning natured chakra is so great, you 
occasionally spark with residual energy. You can power 
most mundane technology passively. The lightning that you 
generate is so potent that it can pierce through even the 
greatest of defenses. 
When casting a Ninjutsu with the lightning release 
keyword, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20 
• Creatures cannot have advantage on saving throws vs 
Ninjutsu you cast with the Lightning release keyword. 
• Reduce the DC made to maintain concentration on 
Ninjutsu with the Lightning Release keyword by-2. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Medical Chakra Penetration
feats.description:
When you gain this feat, choose one of the following 
damage types: Acid, Necrotic or Poison. Ninjutsu, you cast 
ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. 
In addition, when you roll damage for a jutsu you cast 
that deals damage of that type, you can reroll 1’s and 2’s, 
keeping the second result. 
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do 
so, you must choose a different damage type.

feats.name: Medical Release Expert
feats.description:
Every spark of life energy, corrupted dark chakra, or 
poisonous surge you manifest has a small piece of yourself 
within them. You can command the powers of life and death. 
When casting a Ninjutsu with the medical keyword, you 
gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• Acid, Poison or Necrotic damage you deal ignores 
resistance. 
• When you would restore creatures hit points, other than 
yourself, you gain a number of Temporary hit points 
equal to the number of healing dice rolled. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Ninjutsu Archivist
feats.description:
Your Focus in the heat of Combat and mastery of 
Handseals, allow you weave ninjutsu with much greater 
efficiency. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a max of 20 
• You learn an additional ninjutsu that you qualify for. 
This does not count against your Jutsu Known. 
• The next time you would hit 5th, 9th, or 13th level, you 
learn one additional Ninjutsu of 1 rank lower than your 
highest known jutsu rank. 
• If you take this feat after you have passed the 
previously stated levels, you instead gain 1 additional 
D-Rank if passed 5 th level, 1 additional C-Rank if 
passed 9th level, and one additional B-Rank is passed 
13th level

feats.name: Ninshou Theorist
feats.description:
You study the Ninshou arts, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a max of 20. 
• Reduce the Downtime required to Learn, Modify, and 
Create Ninjutsu by 1 week, to a minimum of 1 week. 
• Over the course of a short rest, you attempt to theorize 
and bend the chakra flow of Ninjutsu you know to be 
more effective. Select a number of Ninjutsu you know 
equal to your Intelligence modifier (Max. 4) and make 
an Intelligence (Ninshou) check for each jutsu. The DC 
for each check is based on the rank of the jutsu (D-
Rank: 16, C-Rank: 17, B-Rank: 18, A-Rank: 19, S-Rank: 
20). On a success, until your next rest, each selected 
jutsu is always under one of the following Efficient 
Moldings from the Ninjutsu Specialist Class at no 
additional chakra cost (you may choose a different 
Efficient Molding for each jutsu). 
 ◦ Careful Ninjutsu (Max of 3 creatures.) 
 ◦ Distant Ninjutsu 
 ◦ Piercing Ninjutsu 
 ◦ Subtle Ninjutsu 
 ◦ Tenacious Ninjutsu 
 ◦ Widened Ninjutsu

feats.name: Non-Elemental Specialization
feats.description:
You have begun to specialize in some form of Non-Elemental Ninjutsu, be it Fuinjutsu or Medical Ninjutsu. 
You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one: (Fuinjutsu or Medical). You may ignore 
Hand Seal (HS) requirement for Ninjutsu, with the 
chosen keyword of C-Rank of lower. 
• You deal additional damage with Ninjutsu with the 
chosen Keyword, equal to its rank. ( D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 
2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) 
• You reduce the chakra cost of Ninjutsu, with the 
chosen keyword, by an amount equal to its rank ( D-
Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5).

feats.name: Water Release Expert
feats.description:
You can feel every droplet of water and every molecule of 
chakra flowing within each drop. You can squeeze 
efficiency out of every drop. When casting a Ninjutsu 
with the water release keyword, you gain the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 

• When you are near a sufficient source of water that can 
be used to reduce the cost of the given jutsu cast, 
reduce the cost by 3, instead of 2. 
• When a ninjutsu you cast with the water release 
keyword deals damage to at least one creature, you can 
choose to leave behind a small source of water within 
5ft of one of the affected creature(s). The source of 
water can be used to activate effects that re quires a 
sufficient source of water no more than once, which 
then drains the water source. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Wind Release Expert
feats.description:
Your mastery with wind natured chakra is so great, that 
with but a thought, you can create the sharpest blade made 
exclusively from wind. 
When casting a Ninjutsu with the wind release 
keyword, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 

• When you would trigger a Swirl effect, increase the 
radius by +5 feet. 
• Creatures cannot have advantage on saving throws vs 
Ninjutsu you cast with the Wind release keyword. 
• A jutsu cannot benefit from more than one “X” Release 
Expert feat at a time.

feats.name: Storing Seal Soul
feats.description:
You have created a minor pocket dimension that follows you, 
that you can use to store item inside . You gain the following 
Benefits; 
• You manifest a pocket dimension that you can interact 
with. This pocket dimension has a maximum bulk limit of 
25. 
• As a bonus action you can store any item you are holding or 
wearing into the pocket dimension. 
• As a bonus action you can retrieve any item stored within 
the pocket dimension. 
• If you are reduced to 0 Hit points, all items in your pocket 
dimension are expelled and fall occupying random spaced 
within 10 feet of you. 
• Another creature who is aware of your Pocket dimension 
can cast a jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword targeting you 
and make an Intelligence (Ninshou) check vs your 
Intelligence or Constitution (Ninshou) check. On a success, 
they tear open your pocket dimension pulling out any item 
they are looking for.

feats.name: Assassins Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of Shadows 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in Kunai, Shuriken, and Senbon, if you 
were not already. These Weapons become known as 
Assassin Weapons. 
• When you would deal damage with an Assassin Weapon as a 
result of a weapon attack or Bukijutsu you cast, once per 
turn, you can inflict the Bleeding condition on a target 
creature. 
• You cannot be disarmed of your Assassin Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using an Assassin weapon , 
you can in place of attacks made with said action, make an 
Assassination Attack . Assassination attacks are weapon 
attacks that deal the maximum possible damage with the 
chosen weapon.

feats.name: Bukijutsu Archivist
feats.description:
Your Focus in the heat of Combat and mastery of 
bukijutsu, allow you weave weapon arts together with 
much greater skill. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• You learn an additional bukijutsu that you qualify for. 
This does not count against your Jutsu Known. 
• The next time you would hit 5th, 9th, or 13th level, you 
learn one additional bukijutsu of 1 rank lower than 
your highest known jutsu rank. 
• If you take this feat after you have passed the 
previously stated levels, you instead gain 1 additional 
D-Rank if passed 5 th level, 1 additional C-Rank if 
passed 9th level, and one additional B-Rank if passed 
13th level.

feats.name: Bullseye Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of Bows 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in one set of equipment as these 
weapons become known as Bullseye Weapons. 
 ◦ Short Bows, Long Bows & Heavy Jacket 
 ◦ Light Crossbows, Heavy Crossbows & Heavy Jacket 
• Weapon attacks from a Bullseye Weapon ignores structures 
and constructs that would intercept the damage dealt, 
dealing damage directly to the target creature(s). 
• You cannot be disarmed of your Bullseye Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using a Bullseye weapon 
you can knock 2 shots instead of one. For the remainder of 
this turn, ranged weapon attacks you make with your 
Bullseye Weapon doubles its weapon damage die. Reduce 
your ammunition die by one step, instead of rolling.

feats.name: Dragon Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of 
Dragons either directly or by descension, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Dragon Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu you know, that requires the Dragon Fist Stance 
to be cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu you know, 
that requires you to make no more than two attacks 
become Dragon Fist Taijutsu. Dragon Fist Taijutsu you cast 
gains the Hungry Dragon trait. 
 ◦ Hungry Dragon. Once per casting, when you deal 
your [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature, you 
steal a fraction of their chakra. You regain 
Temporary Chakra points equal to half the result of 
one of your [Unarmed Damage] die rolled (if more 
than 1.). This temporary Chak ra lasts until the 
beginning of your next turn.

feats.name: Drunken Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Monks of 
inebriation either directly or by descension, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Drunken Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Drunken Fist Stance 
to be cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you 
know, that requires you to make no more than two 
taijutsu attacks become Drunken Fist Taijutsu. Drunken 
Fist Taijutsu you cast gain the Gin & Tonic trait. 
 ◦ Gin & Tonic. Once per casting, when you deal your 
[Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature, you are 
able to slip a taste of a special drink enhancing the 
unpredictability of your attacks. Until the beginning 
of your next turn, creatures within 10 feet of you 
cannot gain feature, jutsu or trait-based bonuses to 
their melee attack rolls targeting you.

feats.name: Efficient Breathing
feats.description:
You have begun to master the use of the Heavenly 
Breaths and have learned to manage the stress and 
strain it causes your body. You gain the following 
benefits; 
• You no longer need to pay chakra to maintain 
concentration of any Taijutsu with the Heavenly Breath 
name. 
• You reduce the cost of Taijutsu with the Heavenly 
Breath name by an amount equal to its rank (D-Rank: 
1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5). 
• You can cast a Taijutsu with the Heavenly Breath name 
using either an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction on 
your turn, ignoring its listed casting time. 
• The benefits of Taijutsu with the Heavenly Breath can 
apply to your unarmed and weapon attacks, once per 
turn.

feats.name: Empowered Bukijutsu
feats.description:
You learn to empower your Bukijutsu with technique and 
refined skill, you gain the following benefits: 
• When you cast a bukijutsu you can increase your 
[Weapons Damage] die by 1 step. (d4>d6>d8>d10>d12) 
• When a creature would make a saving throw to resist a 
bukijutsu you cast; If they fail by 5 or more, they take 
additional damage equal to the rank it was cast at ( D-
Rank: 4, C-Rank: 6, B-Rank: 8, A-Rank: 10, S-Rank: 12) 
• When you would make a Constitution (Chakra control) 
check to maintain concentration on a Bukijutsu you cast, 
you can add 1d4 to the result of the check.

feats.name: Empowered Taijutsu
feats.description:
You learn to empower your Taijutsu with more elegant 
technique, you gain the following benefits: 
• When you cast a taijutsu as an action, you can choose 
to also spend your bonus action. If you do, you deal 
additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus, up 
to three times 
• When you cast a taijutsu with the Combo or Finisher 
keyword, reduce the cost by an amount equal to its 
rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-
Rank: 5). Multiple effects with rank-based reduction 
do not stack. 
• When you would make a Constitution (Chakra control) 
check to maintain concentration on a Taijutsu you 
cast, you can make a Martial Arts check instead, using 
your Taijutsu ability modifier.

feats.name: Fighting Stylist
feats.description:
You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty, 
gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• Choose one of the Fighting Stances from Chapter 13. 
• If you possess a Fighting Stance from a Clan Feature 
you possess, you still count as being in this Clan 
Fighting Stance while using a different Fighting 
Stance, for the purpose of casting jutsu only (and vice 
versa). This does not allow you to qualify for feature s 
or feats that are dependent on you being in a specific 
stance. 
• You can select this feat multiple times. You can’t take 
a Fighting Stance option more than once, even if you 
later get to choose again.

feats.name: Frog Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Land of Swamps 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Frog Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu, you know that requires the Frog Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Frog Fist Taijutsu. Frog Fist Taijutsu you cast gain 
the Ribbit trait. 
 ◦ Ribbit. Once per casting, when your Taijutsu attacks 
damage is intercepted by a structure or construct, you 
ignore those structures and constructs dealing damage 
as normal to the original target.

feats.name: Iron Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Masters of 
brawling and metal bending fists, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Iron Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. If you have Combat Bracers this 
instead becomes 1d10 if Strength is your Taijutsu ability 
score. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Iron Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Iron Fist Taijutsu. Iron Fist Taijutsu you cast gain the 
Metal trait. 
 ◦ Metal. Once per casting, when dealing damage to a 
creature with Armor based DR (Damage 
reduction), you can punch through their Armor. 
By spending your Bonus action as part of the 
jutsu’s casting, you can reduce their Armor based 
DR by an amount equal to the result of one of your 
[Unarmed Damage] die. This Armor reduction 
lasts until the affe cted creature spends an Action 
adjusting themselves.

feats.name: Lancer Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of Reeds 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in one set of equipment as these 
weapons become known as Lance Weapons. 
 ◦ Spears, Naginata & Battle Armor 
 ◦ Chained Spear, Sasumata & Battle Armor 
• Lance Weapons gain the Deadly 2 and increase their rank of 
Reach by +1. 
• You cannot be disarmed of your Lance Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using a Lance weapon, you 
can in place of one of the attacks made with said action, 
make a Lance Attack. Lance Attacks are weapon attacks that 
target all creatures in a cone directly in front of you with a 
length equal to your weapons range as your repeated stab 
forward, comparing the single attack roll with all targets 
AC, dealing weapon damage as normal.

feats.name: Light Step Mastery
feats.description:
You’ve mastered the art of fighting while minimally 
armored, treating combat as an elegant dance. While you 
are wearing no armor, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 
20. 
• Whenever an attack roll misses you, you may move 5 
feet without triggering attacks of opportunity. 
• Once per turn, when a creature misses you with an 
attack, your next attack against them deals an 
additional 1d8 damage. 
• When you take the dash action, you may move an 
additional +10 feet. 
• When a creature misses you with an attack, you gain a 
+1 bonus to your AC, up to a maximum of +2, until the 
beginning of your next turn.

feats.name: Lion Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Land of 
Kings, either directly or by descension, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Lion Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. This becomes a d10 against 
a creature with ranks of Fear 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Lion Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Lion Fist Taijutsu. Lion Fist Taijutsu you cast gain 
the Regal trait. 
 ◦ Regal. Once per casting, when you would deal damage 
to a hostile creature with ranks of any Mental 
condition, you gain a +2 bonus to your next saving 
throw before the beginning of your next turn.

feats.name: Ninja Slayer
feats.description:
You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat 
against Shinobi Ninjutsu & Genjutsu, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• When a creature within your weapons range would 
casts a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu, you can use your reaction 
to make an attack of opportunity using your weapon 
targeting the triggering creature. 
• When you damage a creature that is concentrating on 
a Jutsu, that creature has disadvantage on skill checks 
made to maintain concentration. 
• You have advantage on saving throws against Ninjutsu 
& Genjutsu cast by creatures within 10 feet of you.

feats.name: Rabbit Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Warrior 
priestesses from the Land of Hops either directly or by 
descension, gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Rabbit Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Rabbit Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Rabbit Fist Taijutsu. Rabbit Fist Taijutsu you cast 
gain the High Jump Kick trait. 
 ◦ High Jump Kick. Once per casting, you can move up to 
20 feet in any direction. If you would end your 
movement within 5 feet of a creature who was not 
affected by this jutsu’s casting, you immediately make 
1 Unarmed strike against them.

feats.name: Raider Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of War 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in one set of equipment as these 
weapons become known as Raid Weapons. 
 ◦ Hand Axe, Great Axe & Battle Coat 
 ◦ Tekko, War Club & Battle Coat 
• Raid Weapons gain the Disarm, Heavy and Winding weapon 
properties. Raid Weapons with the Heavy property ignores 
the Strength ability score requirement of the property. 
• You cannot be disarmed of your Raid Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using a Raid weapon, you 
can in place one of the attacks made with said action, make 
a Raiding Attack. Raiding Attacks are weapon attacks that 
when you deal damage to a creature wearing armor, you 
reduce their AC by 1 and their armor’s Damage reduction 
by 2, until the beginning of your next turn.

feats.name: Reaper Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of Graves 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in one set of equipment as these 
weapons become known as Reaper Weapons. 
 ◦ Kama, Kusarigama, Scythe & Shinobi Jacket. 
 ◦ Triple-Bladed Scythe & Synthetic Weave. 
• Reaper Weapons increase their Deadly rank by +2 and their 
Critical rank by +1. 
• You cannot be disarmed of Reaper Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using a Reaper weapon, in 
place of one attack made with your attack action you can 
make a Reaping Attack. Reaping Attacks are weapon attacks 
that inflict one rank of Lacerated on a successful hit that 
deals weapon damage to a creature’s hit points.

feats.name: Ronin Training
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the land of Iron 
either directly or by descension, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency in one set of equipment as these 
weapons become known as Ronin Weapons. 
 ◦ Hand Crossbow, Chokuto & Ronin Armor. 
 ◦ Short Bow, Katana & Ronin Armor. 
 ◦ Long Bow, Tachi & Ronin Armor. 
• Ronin Weapons gain Blocking 1, Lethal +1 and Multiattack 
weapon properties. 
• You cannot be disarmed of your Ronin Weapon and they 
cannot be broken while you are wielding them. 
• When you take the attack action using a Ronin Weapon, in 
place of one attack made with your attack action you can 
make a Ronin Attack. Ronin Attacks are weapon attacks 
that deal more damage the less armor a creature has. On a 
hit against a creature with medium armor, deal an 
additional 1d4 damage. On a hit against a creature with 
Chakra armor, deal an additional 1d6 damage. On a hit 
against a creature with Light armor, deal an additional 
1d8 damage. On a hit against a creature with no armor, 
deal an additional 1d10 damage.

feats.name: Serpent Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the serpent masters 
in the land of grass, gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Serpent Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Serpent Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Serpent Fist Taijutsu. Serpent Fist Taijutsu you cast 
gain the Rattling trait. 
 ◦ Rattling. When a hostile creature would trigger an 
attack of opportunity from you, cast a jutsu that 
requires handsigns within 5ft of you or stand up from 
prone while adjacent to you, you can cast this jutsu, as 
a reaction.

feats.name: Shinobi Sentinel
feats.description:
You’ve mastered techniques to take advantage of every 
drop in any enemy’s guard; in tight spaces you are 
indomitable. While you are wielding a melee weapon 
with which you are proficient, you gain the following 
benefits: 
• When you hit a creature with an attack of opportunity, 
the creature’s speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. 
• Creatures within 5 feet of you provoke opportunity 
attacks from you even if they take the Disengage 
action before leaving your reach. 
• If a creature makes an attack of opportunity against 
you, you can as a reaction, make an attack of 
opportunity against them.

feats.name: Silent Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Land of 
Silence either directly or by descension, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Silent Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. If you have Iron Claws this 
instead becomes 1d10 if Dexterity is your Taijutsu ability 
modifier. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Silent Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Silent Fist Taijutsu. Silent Fist Taijutsu you cast gain 
the Echo trait. 
Echo. Once per casting, when you deal [Unarmed 
Damage] to a creature, you leave an Echo of your 
strike, recording the damage dice rolled. If the affected 
creature would attempt to attack or cast a jutsu that 
would be harmful to another creature before the 
beginning of your next turn, you can trigger this echo. 
Reroll the damage die of your echoed strike dealing 
the two highest dice results as damage.

feats.name: Taijutsu Archivist
feats.description:
Your Focus in the heat of Combat and mastery of Martial 
arts, allow you weave taijutsu together with much greater 
skill. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You learn an additional taijutsu that you qualify for. 
This does not count against your Jutsu Known. 
• The next time you would hit 5th, 9th, or 13th level, you 
learn one additional Taijutsu of 1 rank lower than your 
highest known jutsu rank 
• If you take this feat after you have passed the 
previously stated levels, you instead gain 1 additional 
D-Rank if passed 5 th level, 1 additional C-Rank if passed 
9th level, and one additional B-Rank if passed 13 th level.

feats.name: Taijutsu Expertise
feats.description:
Your Focus in the heat of Combat and mastery of the 
martial arts, allow you to fight with much greater 
efficiency. You gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• Select one between Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. You may use 
Dexterity instead of Strength as your Taijutsu Modifier 
when casting the chosen jutsu type. 
• You may use Dexterity instead of Strength for your 
Unarmed Attack and damage rolls. 
• You may use Dexterity when making Martial Arts 
Checks. 
• You may take this feat again, select the jutsu type you 
didn’t select the first time.

feats.name: Weapon Expert
feats.description:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, 
gaining the following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. 
• Select one weapon, with which you are proficient. Once 
per turn, when you roll damage for the chosen weapon, 
you can reroll its damage, using either total. 
• Once per turn, when you would cast a Bukijutsu using a 
weapon, your weapon increases its weapon damage die 
by +1.

feats.name: Weapon Mastery
feats.description:
You have practiced extensively with a single weapon, 
expanding your capabilities with it greatly, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• Select one weapon, with which you are proficient. Then 
select one weapon property from the following list. The 
chosen weapon gains the chosen weapon property 
while you are wielding it or increases the rank of the 
chosen weapon property by +1 while you are wielding it. 
 ◦ Critical (Max 3) 
 ◦ Deadly (Max 3) 
 ◦ Tactical 
 ◦ Winding 
• You can take this feat more than once, picking the 
same weapon and property, different weapon, 
different property or different weapon, same property.

feats.name: Wolf Fist Expert
feats.description:
You have trained under the teachings of the Land of 
Wolves either directly or by descension, gaining the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• While you are in the Wolf Fist Stance, your [Unarmed 
Damage] die becomes a d8. 
• Taijutsu you know that requires the Wolf Fist Stance to be 
cast, and up to two additional Taijutsu that you know, that 
requires you to make no more than two taijutsu attacks 
become Wolf Fist Taijutsu. Wolf Fist Taijutsu you cast gain 
the Howl trait. 
 ◦ Howl. Once per casting, when you deal [Unarmed 
Damage] to a creature, all allies within 15 feet of you, 
excluding yourself are inspired by your aggressive 
assault, gaining a Xd4 bonus to the next instance of 
damage dealt to the same creature as the result of a 
Taijutsu attack, before the beginning of your next turn. 
(X = your proficiency bonus.)

feats.name: 8-Inner Gates: Seimon
feats.description:
You have begun to master the use of the Eight Inner Gates. 
A legendary technique designed to release the limits on a 
user’s chakra pathways, thus increasing their physical 
strength and speed. You learn to unlock 3 of such Inner 
gates; Kaimon, Kyumon and Seimon. Unlocking each gate 
grants additional benefits in addition to the benefits 
granted by the previous gate activated. Gates cannot be 
unlocked out of order. Activating each Inner Gate costs an 
Action, Bonus Action or reaction on your turn. 
While you are gaining the benefit of any Gate you cannot 
cast or maintain the concentration on any Ninjutsu or 
Genjutsu. 
Any Gate you activate can only remain active for 1 
minute or until you deactivate it. You must complete a rest 
to gain the benefit of any Gate granted by this feat. If you 
would attempt to gain the benefit of a Gate granted by this 
feat a second time witho ut taking a rest, you instead must 
spend 2 hit die to do so, which are not recovered until you 
complete a full-rest. When you would end the activation of 
or be forced to end any 8-Inner gate, you gain all Ranks of 
any Fatigue. You lose one ranks of Fatigue every 1 hour; 
• Kaimon. 
 ◦ Str: +2 
 ◦ Speed: +15 
 ◦ +1 Rank of Fatigue 
• Kyumon. 
 ◦ Str: +2 
 ◦ Speed: +15 
 ◦ Spend 2 Hit Die, regaining the result. This can only 
be used once per short rest. 
 ◦ +2 Rank of Fatigue 
• Seimon. 
 ◦ Str: +4 
 ◦ Speed: +10 
 ◦ AC: +1 
 ◦ +2 Rank(s) of Fatigue.

feats.name: 8-Inner Gates: Keimon
feats.prerequisite: 8-Inner Gates: Seimon , Taijutsu Ability Score of 18+, Level 10+
feats.description:
You have learned more masterful technique of the Eight 
Inner Gates, learning to unlock 3 more powerful gates of 
Inner power; Shomon, Tomon and Keimon. 
You must currently be gaining the benefit of Seimon, in 
order to activate Shomon. 
You must complete a rest to gain the benefit of any Gate 
granted by this feat a second time. If you would attempt to 
gain the benefit of a Gate granted by this feat a second time 
without taking a rest, you instead must spend 2 hit die to 
do so, which are not recovered until you complete a full-rest. When you would end the activation of or be forced to 
end any 8-Inner gate, you gain all Ranks of any Fatigue 
and Weakened listed. After ending any gate granted by this 
feature, you lose one rank of Fatigue every 1 hour; 
• Shomon. 
 ◦ Str: +2 
 ◦ Con: +2 
 ◦ Speed: +10 
 ◦ +2 Rank of Fatigue 
• Tomon. 
 ◦ Str: +4 
 ◦ Speed: +10 
 ◦ AC: +1 
 ◦ Extra Action. 
 ◦ +1 Rank of Fatigue 
• Keimon. 
 ◦ Str: +4 
 ◦ Con: +2 
 ◦ Spend 2 hit Dice, regaining the result. This can only be 
used once per short rest. 
 ◦ +2 Rank(s) of Fatigue.

feats.name: 8-Inner Gates: Shimon
feats.prerequisite: 8-Inner Gates: Keimon , Taijutsu Ability Score of 20+, Level 16+
feats.description:
You have become a master of the Eight Inner Gates, 
unlocking the final 2 gates; Kyomon and Shimon 
You must currently be gaining the benefit of Keimon, in 
order to activate Kyomon. 
You must complete a rest to gain the benefit of any Gate 
granted by this feat a second time. If you would attempt to 
gain the benefit of a Gate granted by this feat a second time 
without taking a rest, you instead must spend 2 hit die to do 
so, which are not recovered until you complete a full-rest. 
When you would end the activation of or be forced to end any 
8-Inner gate, you gain all Ranks of any Fatigue and 
Weakened listed. After ending any gate granted by this 
feature, you lose one rank of Fatigue every 24 hours; 
• Kyomon. 
 ◦ Str: +6 
 ◦ AC: +1 
 ◦ +2 Rank of Fatigue 
• Shimon. 
 ◦ Str: +6 
 ◦ Con: +2 
 ◦ Triple Speed. 
 ◦ AC: +2 
 ◦ Extra Action. 
 ◦ You die, slowly turning to dust, which cannot be 
stopped or prevented. You become unable to be revived 
by any means. 
FATIGUE CHART 
Ranks of Fatigue are cumulative, meaning that you retain all effects of 
Fatigue based on the number of ranks currently had. You only gain 
the detriments of Fatigue while you are not gaining the benefits of 
any of the 8-Inner Gates. 
Ranks Effects 
+1 Cannot take the Dash Action. 
+3 Cannot take the Disengage Action. 
+5 Cannot Take the Dodge or Help Actions. 
+7 Move Speed reduced by 15. 
+9 Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity and 
Constitution Ability and skill Checks. 
+11 Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving throws. 
+13 Disadvantage on Strength Saving throws. 
+15 Automatically Fail all Strength, Dexterity and 
Constitution Ability Checks & saving throws.

feats.name: Empowered Genjutsu
feats.description:
You learn to empower your Genjutsu with more 
elaborate illusions. You gain the following benefits: 
• When a creature attempts a saving throw to resist a 
genjutsu you cast on them, you may, as a reaction, 
spend 10 chakra. If you do, until the end of the current 
turn, the affected creature rolls a number of d4 equal 
to the rank of the Genjutsu cast, reducing their saving 
throw by half the result (Min 1). ( D-Rank/C-Rank: 1, 
B-Rank/A-Rank 2, S-Rank: 3) 
• Genjutsu you cast that deal damage on a failed save, 
now deals half damage on a successful save. 
• When you would make a Constitution (Chakra Control) 
check to maintain concentration on a Genjutsu you 
cast, roll a number of d4 equal to the highest rank of 
the genjutsu you are currently concentrating on 
adding half of the result to your check. (Min 1) ( D-
Rank & C-Rank: 1, B-Rank: & A-Rank: 2, S-Rank: 3)

feats.name: Genjutsu Expertise
feats.description:
Your mastery of the Illusionary Arts, allow you to weave 
together Genjutsu with much greater efficiency. You gain 
the following benefits: 
• Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 
20. 
• You may instead use Charisma instead of Wisdom as 
your Genjutsu Modifier. 
• You may instead use Charisma instead of Wisdom for 
Illusions Checks.

feats.name: Genjutsu Archivist
feats.description:
Your encyclopedic knowledge of Genjutsu allows you to 
learn far more Genjutsu than normal. You gain the 
following benefits: 
• Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. 
• You learn an additional genjutsu that you qualify for. 
This does not count against your Jutsu 
Known. 
• The next time you would hit 5th, 9th, 
or 13th level, you learn one 
additional Genjutsu of 1 rank lower 
than your highest known jutsu rank. 
• If you take this feat after you have 
passed the previously stated levels, 
you instead gain 1 additional D-Rank if passed 5 th level, 1 
additional C-Rank if passed 9 th 
level, and one additional B-Rank is passed 13 th level.

feats.name: Sensory Specialization
feats.description:
You have begun to specialize in a subset of illusions of 
your choice. You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one Sensory Keyword (Auditory, Visual, Inhaled ). 
You may ignore Hand Seal (HS) requirement for 
Genjutsu of C-Rank of lower with your chosen 
keyword. 
• You deal additional damage with Genjutsu with your 
chosen Sensory Keyword, equal to its rank. ( D-Rank: 1, 
C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) 
• You reduce the chakra cost of Genjutsu with your 
chosen Sensory keyword by an amount equal to its 
rank. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-
Rank: 5). Multiple effects with rank-based reduction 
do not stack. 
• You can take this feat multiple times, each time 
selecting a different sensory keyword.

feats.name: Psychic Penetration
feats.description:
You have learned to more easily damage your opponents' 
psyches. You gain the following benefits; 
• Genjutsu, you cast ignore resistance to psychic 
damage. 
• When you would roll damage for a genjutsu you cast 
that deals psychic damage, you can reroll 1’s and 2’s, 
keeping the second result. 
• When you deal psychic damage to a creature, the select 
creature gains disadvantage on ability checks and 
saving throws made to end any Sensory or Mental 
conditions until the end of their next turn.

feats.name: Illusionary Theorist
feats.prerequisite: Wisdom or Charisma 15+, Proficiency in Illusions
feats.description:
You study the Illusionary arts, gaining the following 
benefits: 
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20. 
• Reduce the Downtime required to Learn, Modify, and 
Create Genjutsu by 1 week, to a minimum of 1 week. 
• Over the course of a short rest, you attempt to theorize 
and bend the chakra flow of Genjutsu you know to be 
more effective. Select a number of Genjutsu you 
know equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier 
(Max. 4) and make an Wisdom or Charisma (Illusions) 
check for each jutsu. The DC for each check is based on 
the rank of the jutsu (D-Rank: 16, C-Rank: 17, B-Rank: 
18, A-Rank: 19, S-Rank: 20). On a success, until your 
next rest, each selected jutsu is always under one of 
the following Onijutsu from the Kurama Clan at no 
additional chakra cost (you may choose a different 
Onijutsu for each jutsu). 
 ◦ Careful Onijutsu (Max of 3 creatures.) 
 ◦ Overwhelming Onijutsu 
 ◦ Tenacious Onijutsu 
 ◦ Subtle Onijutsu

feats.name: Empathic Expert
feats.description:
You can feel every thought. Every intent. Every passing 
idea. When casting a Genjutsu that does not deal 
damage, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20 
• When you would cast a Genjutsu that targets a single 
creature, on a failed save, that creatures’ movement 
speed is reduced by 20 feet for the duration. 
• When you would cast a Genjutsu that can affect two or 
more creatures at once, on a failed save, once per turn, 
all affected creatures take psychic damage whenever 
one of the other affected creatures take damage of any 
type, excluding the creature that trig gers this effect. 
The number of psychic damage creatures take is an 
amount equal to the rank of the jutsu currently 
affecting them all. (D-Rank: 2d4, C-Rank: 4d4, B-Rank: 
6d4, A-Rank: 8d4, S-Rank: 10d4)

feats.name: Psychic Expert
feats.description:
You can feel every migraine. Every headache. Every 
painful thought. When casting a Genjutsu that deals 
damage, you gain the following benefits: 
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• Once per turn, when a creature under the effects of a 
Genjutsu you cast would remake a saving throw to end 
the Genjutsu’s effects, they make their saving throw 
with a-1d4 penalty. 
• Once per turn, when a hostile creature would take 
damage, you can choose to Mentally Scar the creature. 
A creature who is mentally scarred suffers a-1d4 
penalty to end any Mental condition they are under the 
effects of. 
• Genjutsu you cast that requires an attack roll, has their 
range increased by 30 feet.

feats.name: Psychosis Adept
feats.prerequisite: Pain, Doubled Pain or Unlimited Pain, Level 4+
feats.description:
You’ve become adept at causing immense psychotic pain to 
others minds. The advanced techniques you’ve learned while 
delving into this specialty has granted you the following 
benefits: 
• The prerequisite jutsu does not cost chakra to maintain 
concentration, if they do. 
• When the prerequisite jutsu deals damage, add your 
genjutsu ability modifier to the damage rolled . 
• If an affected creature would be reduced to 0 hit points as a 
result of the prerequisite jutsu, you can choose another 
creature within 10 feet of the original target to target, 
moving the jutsu to that new target. 
• Creatures cannot end the effects of the prerequisite 
genjutsu on themselves with a jutsu of equal level to it.

feats.name: Psychosis Expert
feats.description:
You’ve become adept at causing unmatched psychotic 
trauma to others minds. You gain the following benefits: 
• The Pain genjutsu no longer ends when its effect is first 
applied. 
• The Doubled Pain genjutsu increases its damage die by 1 
step. 
• The Unlimited Pain genjutsu no longer needs a direct line of 
sight, instead so long as you know the target creatures 
name, they can hear you, and they are within range, they 
suffer its effects as normal.

feats.name: Psychosis Master
feats.description:
You’ve become a master at breaking the minds of your 
adversaries. Enemies fall into mental coma’s when they do 
battle with you. You gain the following benefits: 
• The Pain genjutsu damage die becomes a d6. 
• The Doubled Pain genjutsu triggers whenever the target 
takes damage from a source other than you, once per turn. 
• The Unlimited Pain genjutsu can force the target to make 
an Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw to resist its effects. 
You decide the saving throw when the jutsu is cast. 
• You can concentrate on all 3 prerequisite genjutsu at once 
If you would end the effect of Doubled Pain as a result of 
Unlimited Pain you instead maintain concentration on it, 
while also gaining the upgraded benefits of Unlimited Pain.

feats.name: Lord Of Darkness
feats.prerequisite: Puppets of Darkness, Shadow Bite or Weapons of Darkness, Level 4+ Weaving darkness into and out of both your Genjutsu, and
feats.description:
the minds of your enemies. The shadows become your friend. 
The oldest friend one could ask for. You gain the following 
benefits: 
• The prerequisite Genjutsu can deal Necrotic damage when 
cast. 
• The prerequisite jutsu can inflict 1 rank of Dazzled when it 
deals damage on a failed wisdom saving throw. 
• If you score a critical hit with the prerequisite Genjutsu, 
you can choose to inflict the Confused condition. 
• Twice per rest, you can choose to cast one of the 
prerequisite jutsu as a bonus action. If you could already 
cast the prerequisite jutsu as a bonus action, you can 
instead cast it at no action cost.

feats.name: Thought Provoker
feats.prerequisite: Level 4+ Each illusion you manifest, grants you the insight into thoughts and feelings of those you mentally assault. You gain
feats.description:
the following benefits: 
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast that requires an Intelligence saving throw, you 
can ask one question, telepathically that the target 
unconsciously answers with 5 words or less. 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast that requires a Wisdom saving throw, you become 
aware if the target creature feels if they are enjoying the 
combat or if they feel like they are forced to by another 
creature, entity or for ce. 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast that requires a Charisma saving throw, the target 
finds it difficult to lie or withhold its true feelings verbally 
until the end of its next turn.

feats.name: Intelligence Drain
feats.prerequisite: Level 12+ Each illusion you manifest, sucks the intelligence and knowledge from their target. You gain the following benefits:
feats.description:
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast or you score a successful hit with a Genjutsu 
attack the target suffers a-1 penalty to their next 
Intelligence saving throw. This can stack up to-5. 
• When a creature would suffer a-1 penalty to their next 
Intelligence saving throw as a result of this feature, you 
gain a +1 bonus to your next intelligence saving throw. This 
can stack up to +5. 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast by 5 or more, you can select one piece of 
information that you wish to know. If the target knows 
anything in relation to this piece of information, you 
become aware of it.

feats.name: Wisdom Drain
feats.prerequisite: Level 12+ Each illusion you manifest, sucks the wit, cunning and wisdom from their target. You gain the following benefits:
feats.description:
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast or you score a successful hit with a Genjutsu 
attack the target suffers a-1 penalty to their next Wisdom 
saving throw. This can stack up to-5. 
• When a creature would suffer a-1 penalty to their next 
Wisdom saving throw as a result of this feature, you gain a 
+1 bonus to your next Wisdom saving throw. This can stack 
up to +5. 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast by 5 or more, you gain one special sense they have 
as they lose it. You retain this special sense for the 
remaining duration that the original target would have it. 
If there was no set dura tion, it defaults to being 1 minute.

feats.name: Charisma Drain
feats.prerequisite: Level 12+ Each illusion you manifest, sucks the charisma, charm, or intimidating factors from their target. You gain the following benefits:
feats.description:
• Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a 
maximum of 20 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast or you score a successful hit with a Genjutsu 
attack the target suffers a-1 penalty to their next Charisma 
saving throw. This can stack up to-5. 
• When a creature would suffer a-1 penalty to their next 
Charisma saving throw as a result of this feature, you gain 
a +1 bonus to your next Charisma saving throw. This can 
stack up to +5. 
• When a creature would fail the saving throw of a Genjutsu 
you cast by 5 or more, they gain vulnerability to the next 
instance of psychic damage they take.

feats.name: Bloodthirsty Critical
feats.description:
You fight with reckless abandon, caring not of your own 
safety. You use your pain to fuel your attacks, causing 
your enemies even greater pain. You gain the following 
benefits: 
• Select one of the following.; 
 ◦ Ninjutsu attacks 
 ◦ Taijutsu attacks 
 ◦ Genjutsu attacks 
• When a creature would deal damage to you as the 
result of a melee attack, you gain a +1 bonus to your 
critical threat range of the chosen type, no more than 
twice per round, until the beginning of your next turn. 
• When a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with a 
melee attack, you can use your reaction to cause the 
attack to hit you. You can immediately make a melee 
weapon attack against that creature. 
• When a creature scores a critical hit against you with 
an attack, the next attack you make, before the end of 
your next turn, that hits the creatures who scored a 
critical hit against you, counts as a critical hit.

feats.name: Cerebral Critical
feats.description:
You learn to bruise both your enemies mind and body in 
a single strike. You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one of the following. 
 ◦ Taijutsu attacks 
 ◦ Genjutsu attacks 
• Once per turn, when you score a critical hit with the 
chosen attack type, the target creature gains 1 rank of 
Concussed. 
• You can take this feat more than once, each time 
selecting the same or different attack type

feats.name: Combat Seal Weaver
feats.description:
You’ve practiced making your jutsu more difficult to 
avoid, learning techniques that grant you the following 
benefits: 
• When a creature would make a saving throw against 
damage from a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast and they 
would fail the saving throw by 5 or more, increase the 
damage by the rank of jutsu Cast. (D-Rank: +5, 
C-Rank: +10, B-Rank: +15, A-Rank: +25, S-Rank: +25). 
• When a creature would make a saving throw against a 
Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast that inflicts a condition 
and they would fail by 5 or more, regardless of the 
jutsu’s effect, the next time they would successfully 
remake the saving throw or succeed the che ck needed 
to remove the condition (if applicable), they instead 
do not remove the condition.

feats.name: Critical Defense Mastery
feats.description:
While you are wearing heavy armor with which you are 
proficient, you gain the following benefits: 
• Twice per Long Rest, when a hostile creature would 
score a critical hit against you, you can treat it as a 
normal hit. You regain one use of this effect, on a short 
rest. 
• You gain 5 DR (Damage reduction) vs the damage 
applied from a Critical hit. 
• When an allied creature within 10 feet of you would be 
hit by a critical attack, you may spend your reaction to 
redirect the attack to yourself. You can do this once per 
initiative.

feats.name: Disgusting Critical
feats.description:
When you score a critical hit. The environment and terrain 
bellows as sickening cry at your power. You gain the 
following benefits: 
• Select one damage type from the following; 
 ◦ Acid 
 ◦ Poison 
 ◦ Necrotic 
• You can take this feat more than once, each time selecting 
a different damage type. 
• Critical Hits with the chosen damage type pierces Passive 
damage reduction and up to half of a creature’s Active 
damage reduction from Jutsu. 
• Once per round, when you score a critical hit, the affected 
creature gains 1 rank of the listed conditions based on the 
damage type of the attack: 
 ◦ Acid – Corroded. 
 ◦ Poison – Envenomed. 
 ◦ Necrotic – Bleeding.

feats.name: Elemental Critical
feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, At least one Nature Affinity
feats.description:
You learn to infuse your nature affinity into your 
powerful blows. You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one of the following. 
 ◦ Ninjutsu attacks 
 ◦ Taijutsu attacks 
• Once per round, when you score a critical hit with the 
chosen attack type, the target creature gains 1 rank of 
one of the listed conditions based on the Nature 
affinities you have if it is a Ninjutsu attack, or the 
affinities you have if it is a Taijutsu a ttack. 
 ◦ Earth – Bruised. 
 ◦ Wind – Bleed. 
 ◦ Fire – Burned. 
 ◦ Water – Chilled. 
 ◦ Lightning – Shocked. 
• You can take this feat more than once, each time 
selecting a different attack type

feats.name: Enhanced Critical
feats.description:
Your ability to strike a place with zeal and efficacy grows. 
You gain the following benefits: 
• Select one of the following. Attacks made with the 
select type have a +1 critical threat range; 
 ◦ Ninjutsu attacks 
 ◦ Taijutsu attacks 
 ◦ Genjutsu attacks 
• You can take this feat more than once, each time 
selecting the same or different attack type.

feats.name: Fanatic
feats.description:
Every blow that hits your enemies make you feel closer to 
victory, making you shake in excitement. You gain the 
following benefits: 
• Allied creatures within 20 feet of you gain a +1 bonus to 
their critical threat range so long as they do not have any 
bonuses to their critical threat range due to another 
Critical Feat. 
• When you or an allied creature score a critical hit on a 
creature that reduces their hit points to 0, you gain the 
Fanatics Rush special action. You can gain this special 
action, once per round. 
 ◦ Fanatics Rush. On your turn, you can take this special 
action to regain 1d6+your proficiency bonus hit 
points and make one weapon attack.

feats.name: Improved Critical
feats.description:
You learn how to capitalize on the faults in your 
opponent’s guard and control the flow of combat. You 
gain the following benefits: 
• Select one of the following;
